q131_scenarios.description: A raw supported image reaches provisioned and then separately commissioned state with exact first-boot, Ansible, identity, release, and recovery evidence.
The exact qualified candidate is fetched, verified, deployed, activated, rolled back, withdrawn or marked unsafe, and replaced without bypassing protected publication policy.
Prepared online and fully offline field-development and qualified workflows operate through III CLI with native GC and no onboard source or build dependency.
Interrupted transfer, activation, receiver update, network, storage, clock, power, and credential failures recover to an authenticated old or new pair.
Real and simulation tuning, cold restart, capture, reconciliation, comparison, deliberate promotion, release deployment, and rollback preserve exact provenance.
A replacement GC verifies, restores, and rearchives all declared non-secret records while new machine identity and credentials are generated.
Representative GC-only, aircraft-only, paired deploy, diagnostics, tuning capture, rollback, and recovery complete from prepared caches with network denied.
The offline operator manual, generated CLI and schema references, package links, and documentation manifest match the exact candidate and pass the documentation gate.
A clean workstation and commissioned target operate with legacy clones and caches absent, every retired entry point fails with the canonical replacement, and archive metadata is verified.
